prior_summary: Blue-goal-relative world Cartesian targets directly anchor carry descent, release and retreat to the observed destination; world quaternion and gripper are learned jointly.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when blue visibly co-moves with the gripper and is elevated, already traveling toward blue_goal, or near the destination where placement accuracy dominates. It can also accept a plausible late upstream handoff.
termination_guidance: Hand off when blue is stationary inside blue_goal with gripper open and TCP clear, or after the optional supervised tail has visibly secured and begun lifting buffered red.
limitations: Goal anchoring does not make source pickup invariant, has no contact truth and cannot prove blue is held. Quaternion normalization is a projection. Shifted goals may be unreachable; drops, collisions and wrong-object grasps are not demonstrated recoveries. Prefer h01 for gross source displacement and h03 for moderate execution offsets.
